note: Free public Solana mainnet-beta RPC, verified with getGenesisHash against the mainnet genesis. Keyless public Solana RPC is scarce, so a provider key added in the endpoint settings is the recommended upgrade. The websocket rows carry accountSubscribe on each owner and its associated token accounts, which wakes a sync pass when a watched balance moves, and each was verified by subscribing and receiving a push. Without a personal token, PublicNode refuses getTokenAccountsByOwner and any batch with more than one getTransaction, and never answers logsSubscribe, so the adapter reads token accounts by address and fetches each transaction in its own request.
